messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: Elevated 5xx rate detected on edge-gateway (us-west-2). 10m spike, p95 latency 1.2s, 5xx rate 9.4% (baseline 0.3%). Auto-pager triggered. Incident channel: #incidents

sasha: I'm on it — paging @aj and @maria. Any recent deploys to edge-gateway?

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: service=edge-gateway commit=abcd1234 env=prod @ 2026-03-15T10:20:12Z

aj: I see traffic spike and lots of upstream_reset and downstream connection failures in envoy logs. Examples:
```
[2026-03-15T10:22:34Z] envoy upstream reset: reason=connection_failure host=10.1.5.23:8080
[2026-03-15T10:22:35Z] route_retry: attempt=2 status=504
```

maria: Also seeing many repeated retries from LB. Route config has `retry_policy` with `num_retries: 3` and `retry_on: 5xx,connect-failure` on that route. That could be amplifying.

ops-lead: Quick hypothesis: a backend shard is flakey -> LB retries amplify -> circuit breakers trip on healthy hosts -> cascade. Mitigation: disable retries at proxy, restore previous route weights to avoid shard hotspot, and increase upstream capacity.

sasha: Agreed. Can someone patch envoy route to set `retry_policy: null` or `num_retries: 0`? I'll prepare a temp rollback.

aj: Patching route now. Command:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-routes --patch '{"data":{"edge-route":"..."}}'
```
Applying change to prod (dry-run first).

maria: Rollout started -> config update applied to 3/6 frontdoors, 6/6 in 2min left. Watching errors.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Config patch applied to 6 frontdoors at 10:26:03Z

support-lead: Customer impact: requests to /v1/generate returning 502/504 intermittently for EU and US-west only. Estimated affected users ~1200 req/min. No billing impact reported yet, but user-facing failures.

security: Any sign of malicious traffic? No, LB logs show normal client IP distribution; high peak from known batch job in us-west.

aj: After disabling retries, 5xx rate dropped from 9.4% -> 1.1% over 3 minutes. p95 latency improved. Looks like retries were amplifying upstream failures.

ops-lead: Next actions: 1) keep retries disabled for 30m; 2) investigate failing upstream host 10.1.5.23 (health checks flapping); 3) plan a canary route weight rollback from yesterday's weight shift that increased traffic to that shard; 4) document RCA steps.

maria: Starting health-check and node reprobe on host 10.1.5.23. If it fails to recover, cordon and drain.

sasha: On-call handoff to @maria at 10:40Z. I'll bump to Sev2 and open a ticket for postmortem.

incident-bot: :page_with_curl: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-42 (Sev2) by sasha

support-lead: Notifying top 10 enterprise customers about degraded availability in us-west/eu. Template going out.

aj: Follow-up: I captured envoy trace and relevant config diff; attaching excerpt:
```
- retry_policy:
-   num_retries: 3
-   retry_on: 5xx,connect-failure
+ # disabled temporarily
```

maria: Host 10.1.5.23 shows OOM events in kernel logs around spike. Ops will drain and reimage. Taking host out of pool.

ops-lead: Post-mitigation plan: revert weight change from 2026-03-14 23:10, add canary at 5% for 1h, and add automatic retry budget limiter in edge-gateway to avoid amplification.

sasha: Great. Closing paging loop for now — continue monitoring. Last check 10:45Z 5xx steady at 0.9%. Will update incident timeline in ticket.

incident-bot: :lock: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Last update 2469812660
